recording.method: Actual browser screenshots encoded as15fps WebM; capture cadence is not a rendering-performance benchmark.

limitations: Real desktop WebKit26 with iPhone emulation and Chromium. Touch dismissal checks non-cancellation of a synthetic touchstart; no physical swipe performance claim. Hidden-document case uses a synthetic visibilitychange. Encoded video FPS is not a rendering FPS measurement.
anchorRecheck: Initial fixed400ms assertion sampled a still-running native smooth anchor after pause reload removed the QA auto-scroll override. Targeted recheck waited for native anchor settlement; application code unchanged.
